text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Parcae... understands me. They take the
data I input and guide me to
the correct
answer. Adhering only to truth, they do
what I want them
to and do it well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As long as I give them the right input, the
output is absolute. The
perfect,
all-encompassing, well-defined equation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But because of that... Parcae can't understand me. In their world of ones and zeros, the process of despair simply doesn't exist.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm on the lookout for a racer to scout, so I
stop by practice. There, a
number of
Umamusume who haven't made their
debuts yet gather to
train.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Opera O and Top Road are both so cool...
I may never catch up, but...
I have to try!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As expected of the prestigious Tracen
Academy, all the students
have promise.
As I watch them excitedly, I notice
something out of
the corner of my eye...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Beside me is an Umamusume observing the
runners on the track. Her
serious gaze
occasionally shifts to her laptop, where
she seems to be
typing something.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her gaze isn't fixed on the racers in front
of her, or even her laptop
screen... They
seem to be searching for something...
desperately so.
...Tch!
Hmph...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you see that? Air Shakur seriously
freaks me out. I can't believe she
glared at
an adult like that...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
But isn't she, like, a genius or something?
Even Teach said she's got the brains
and
skills... It's just the way she does things
that's off.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, she's always out till just
before curfew. I bet she's up to no good...

Maybe that's why she's so prickly... I don't
know what goes on in her head.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur... It looks like she's got quite
the fearsome reputation, and
perhaps
rightfully so. That uniquely fierce stare left
quite the
impression on me.

Like. I. Said. I'm not doing anything, so
what's the big deal?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That night, as I'm returning to the school
from a quick trip into town, I
spot an
Umamusume being stopped by the police.

Every damn time, you stop me. And for
what? It's not even that late...
Ah.

text_block_list.name: Police Officer
text_block_list.text: Hm? You there... Do you know this girl?

text_block_list.name: Police Officer
text_block_list.text:
So you're from the academy... Good. I'll
hand you over to your
teacher now. No
more wandering around so late at night,
got it?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Hand me over"? Way to treat me like a
criminal. And based on
nothing but
assumptions at that.

text_block_list.name: Police Officer
text_block_list.text:
That's not it! You're always in those net
cafes till late. I'm just worried
you'll get
wrapped up in something bad... You're so
stubborn!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Something tells me that unless I say
something, these two will just
keep
bickering...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Police Officer
text_block_list.text:
...If that's the case, fine. However, you
shouldn't leave minors
unattended for so
long. As for you, if you're waiting for your
teacher,
just say so!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I take Air Shakur back to the dorms after
bidding the policeman good
night. She
doesn't say a word to me the entire way
back...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...That all you're gonna say? I was out till
curfew, and I know my
reputation around
school's not great. It's obvious you'd be
suspicious.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Lemme guess, you just don't want to deal
with this crap, right? In that
case, I
wholeheartedly agree.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The way she looked this afternoon tells me
everything I need to
know. I can't imagine
anyone with that stern gaze doing
something
that could jeopardize her
career.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Instead... I imagine she was simply looking
for somewhere she can
concentrate in
order to continue her work, whatever it is.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
So you're not even going to investigate
further? You're just letting me
go because
of baseless impressions and feelings...
You're no better
than that cop.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ultimately, everyone just sees what they
want to see—mixing desires
into
decisions... and your minds suffer for it.
That’s why I chase the
truth... You're
unreliable, unlike my partner.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch... My PC. But they're more than just a
machine, okay?  They're
like another
brain—a partner capable of giving me all
the answers.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Based on all the data I collect, they can
give me the most efficient
regimen, a
surefire strategy for scrimmages... and
whatever else I
need.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
As long as I don't mess up during data
entry, they'll spit out the right
answer. And
they give it to me straight too, none of
that vague crap.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
But Parcae can only help those who want
to help themselves. That's
why we work so
well. I’m more than willing to follow the
path they set
for me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Yeah, no duh. I made them myself after all.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Gross much?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Looks like I've upset her once again... So I
decide to head back to my
room,
reminding myself to mind my words and
actions going forward.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Shakur! You're finally baaack! U-um,
uh... Are you... Um, weeell...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...I was organizing some of my data. It's just
easier to concentrate at a
cafe than here.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And I thought I told you, you don't have
to wait up for me. The entire
reason I leave
is so you... Whatever, let's just sleep.
We've gotta be
up early.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Okayyy... Um, that reminds me... Shakur, a
trainer is going to observe
your training
tomorrow, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
They want to see what I can do. I mean, I'll
run, but... I know it's going
to end the
same as always. It's not even worth running
a simulation.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Either way, it doesn't concern you. I'm
turning off the light.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...I knew it. The answer didn't change.

C’ｍon, Parcae...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Parcae... You were born of my obsession
with the Twinkle Series.
Everything from
your OS to the applications you use—I
made you
myself.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Based on your analysis, I should be
debuting soon. My physical
condition is
improving as predicted. However...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: (That number hasn't changed. Which makes sense, since the code is right. That number is absolute.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(So why do I... keep redoing it? Analysis?
Verification? Desperation?
What is it...)
